title: 高層建築核心筒滑模施工~Slipform construction of high-rise cores
focus: 讓模板在混凝土初凝時連續上升：滑升速度、出模強度、千斤頂荷重與垂直度控制~Moving forms upward continuously as concrete sets: slip rate, exit strength, jack loads and verticality control
summary: 滑模把核心筒牆體當成一條不停的生產線：約 1.2 m 高的模板由千斤頂沿爬桿每隔數分鐘上升一小段，下緣出模的混凝土必須已能自立，上方同時綁紮鋼筋、安裝埋件並澆置。本課以 CN Tower、ThyssenKrupp 羅特魏爾試驗塔與亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔為例，說明滑升速度與凝結時間、爬桿挫屈、埋件協調、垂直度與扭轉控制、冷縫與養護、以及竣工紀錄。~Slipforming turns a core wall into a non-stop production line: forms about 1.2 m high are jacked up rods a small step every few minutes, concrete leaving the bottom edge must already stand on its own, and above it crews fix rebar, set embeds and place concrete at the same time. Using the CN Tower, the ThyssenKrupp test tower in Rottweil and the elevator test tower in Atlanta, the course covers slip rate versus setting time, climbing-rod buckling, embed coordination, verticality and twist control, cold joints and curing, and as-built records.

units.anchor: 連續滑升工序~Continuous slipform cycle
units.title: 滑模原理與核心筒的適用條件~Slipform principle and when cores suit it
units.mechanism: 滑模是一組沿牆體全周連續的模板，由頂部工作平台與軛架連成整體，千斤頂夾住埋在牆中的爬桿往上爬，帶動模板、平台與懸吊的修飾架一起上升。混凝土在模板內停留數小時，從頂部澆入、到下緣出模時已經初凝，可以支撐自身重量。因為模板不拆不組，核心筒每天可上升數公尺，但前提是斷面在高度方向少變化、開口與埋件能在滑升中連續安裝，且全天候不中斷供料。CN Tower 的混凝土塔身就是以液壓爬升千斤頂推動的模具連續成形，並在升高過程中逐步收窄形成錐形。~A slipform is a continuous ring of forms around the whole wall, tied by yokes to a working deck on top; jacks grip climbing rods embedded in the wall and climb them, lifting the forms, deck and hanging finishing scaffolds together. Concrete stays in the form for several hours, entering at the top and leaving the bottom edge after initial set, able to carry its own weight. Because nothing is struck and re-erected, a core can rise several metres a day, provided the section changes little with height, openings and embeds can be installed on the move and concrete supply continues around the clock. The CN Tower's concrete shaft was formed this way by a mould driven up by hydraulic climbing jacks, narrowing gradually as it rose to form the taper.
units.model: 滑升速度 0.10 m/h、全天 24 h 連續作業時日升 2.4 m；120 m 核心筒需 120/2.4 = 50 天，若計入 10% 的停機與調整時間，約需 50/0.9 ≈ 56 天。數值為教學假設。~At 0.10 m/h around the clock the core rises 2.4 m a day; a 120 m core takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, or about 50/0.9 ≈ 56 days allowing 10% for stoppages and adjustments. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在施工規劃階段比較滑模、跳模與自動爬模在工期、人力、混凝土供應與安全上的差異，確認核心筒斷面變化、開口數量、埋件密度與供料能力都支持連續作業；以排程模擬檢查預期停機次數。~At planning stage compare slipform, jump form and automatic climbing form for programme, labour, concrete supply and safety, and confirm that section changes, the number of openings, embed density and supply capacity all support continuous work; use schedule simulation to check the expected number of stoppages.
units.failure: 核心筒斷面每隔幾層就改變牆厚或退縮，滑模被迫頻繁停機改裝，連續作業的優勢消失，反而增加冷縫與品質風險；混凝土供應中斷時，模板內混凝土在靜止中與模板黏結，再啟動時表面被撕裂。~If the core changes wall thickness or steps back every few storeys, the slipform must stop frequently for modification, losing its continuous advantage and adding cold joints and quality risk; if concrete supply is interrupted, concrete in the stationary form bonds to the panels and the surface tears when sliding resumes.
units.misconception: 滑模適用於所有高層核心筒，只要速度夠快就一定比較省工期。~Slipforming suits every high-rise core and is always faster if the rate is high enough.
units.practice: 決定採用滑模前，要求建築與結構設計把牆厚變化、退縮與開口集中在少數高程，並與滑模專業廠商共同檢討；同時確認預拌廠與運輸能 24 小時供料，且有備援廠。~Before choosing slipform, ask the architectural and structural designers to concentrate wall-thickness changes, setbacks and openings at a few levels and review them with the slipform specialist; confirm that the ready-mix plant and haulage can supply 24 hours a day with a back-up plant.

units.anchor: 出模混凝土強度~Concrete strength at form exit
units.title: 凝結時間、模板高度與容許滑升速度~Setting time, form height and allowable slip rate
units.mechanism: 滑模的核心限制是：混凝土從頂部澆入到從下緣出模的時間，必須長於它達到初凝、可自立的時間。若滑升太快，出模混凝土仍呈塑性，會坍落、鼓出或被模板拖裂；若太慢，混凝土在模板內硬化並與模板黏結，滑升時表面被撕開。凝結時間受水泥種類、緩凝劑、混凝土溫度與氣溫強烈影響，所以滑升速度必須隨日夜溫度調整，而不是固定一個數字。亞特蘭大試驗塔的模板高約 1.2 m（4 ft）。~The governing limit of slipforming is that the time from placing at the top to leaving the bottom edge must exceed the time the concrete needs to reach initial set and stand on its own. If sliding is too fast, concrete leaving the form is still plastic and slumps, bulges or is dragged and torn; if too slow, concrete hardens in the form and bonds to it, tearing the surface when sliding resumes. Setting time depends strongly on cement type, retarders, concrete temperature and air temperature, so the slip rate must follow day and night temperatures rather than stay fixed. The forms on the Atlanta test tower were about 1.2 m (4 ft) high.
units.model: 容許滑升速度 v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set。模板 1.2 m、頂部預留 0.2 m 時有效高度 h_eff = 1.0 m；20°C 時初凝 4 h，v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h；10°C 時凝結時間約加倍為 8 h，v_max 降為 0.125 m/h。實際速度還要留裕度。數值為教學假設。~Allowable slip rate v_max ≈ h_eff/t_set. With a 1.2 m form and 0.2 m freeboard, h_eff = 1.0 m; at 20°C with initial set at 4 h, v_max = 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h; at 10°C setting roughly doubles to 8 h and v_max drops to 0.125 m/h. Actual rates keep a margin below these. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 開工前以試拌在不同溫度做凝結時間試驗（貫入阻力法），建立溫度與初凝時間關係；施工中每班以手指按壓或小型貫入計檢查出模面，並記錄混凝土溫度、氣溫與滑升速度，速度調整需由滑模工程師簽記。~Before starting, run setting-time tests by penetration resistance on trial batches at several temperatures to relate temperature to initial set; during work check the exit surface each shift by thumb pressure or a small penetrometer, log concrete temperature, air temperature and slip rate, and have the slipform engineer sign every rate change.
units.failure: 夜間降溫時仍維持白天速度，出模混凝土未凝結而坍落，牆面出現鼓脹與水平裂縫；白天高溫時速度太慢，混凝土黏住模板，滑升時表面被拉出水平撕裂帶，嚴重時鋼筋外露，需大面積修補。~Keeping the daytime rate as temperatures fall at night lets unset concrete slump out of the form, leaving bulges and horizontal cracks; sliding too slowly in daytime heat lets concrete bond to the form so that each lift drags out horizontal tear bands, in bad cases exposing bars and requiring extensive repair.
units.misconception: 滑模的速度越快越好，只要千斤頂能力足夠就可以一直加速。~The faster the slipform the better; it can keep accelerating as long as the jacks are strong enough.
units.practice: 施工計畫應以溫度—速度對照表管理滑升，並規定每班出模面檢查的方法與紀錄；配比中的緩凝劑用量變更須由混凝土供應商與滑模工程師共同同意並先做試驗。~Manage slipping with a temperature-versus-rate table in the method statement, specify how the exit surface is checked and recorded each shift, and require joint agreement and prior trials by the concrete supplier and slipform engineer for any change in retarder dosage.

units.anchor: 千斤頂與爬桿~Jacks and climbing rods
units.title: 爬桿、千斤頂與平台荷重~Climbing rods, jacks and deck loads
units.mechanism: 滑模的全部重量，包括模板、軛架、工作平台、懸吊修飾架、堆放材料、人員以及模板與混凝土之間的摩擦力，都由數十到上百支千斤頂經爬桿傳入已硬化的牆體。爬桿在剛硬化的混凝土與千斤頂之間有一段未受側向支撐的長度，容易挫屈；因此實際能用的單支荷重常由爬桿挫屈而非千斤頂額定值控制。美國 OSHA 1926.703 規定爬桿須為專用設計且在未埋入混凝土處要適當支撐，千斤頂荷重不得超過額定能力，並須有斷電時自動鎖住的機械裝置。~The entire weight of the slipform, including forms, yokes, deck, hanging finishing scaffolds, stored materials, people and the friction between forms and concrete, passes through dozens or over a hundred jacks and their climbing rods into the hardened wall. Between the newly hardened concrete and the jack each rod has an unbraced length that is prone to buckling, so the usable load per rod is often governed by rod buckling rather than the jack rating. US OSHA 1926.703 requires climbing rods to be specifically designed and braced where not encased in concrete, jack loads to stay within rated capacity, and automatic holding devices to hold the forms if power fails.
units.model: 爬桿 48.3×4 mm 鋼管，I ≈ 137,700 mm⁴、無支撐長 1.5 m，P_cr = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×137,700/1,500² ≈ 121 kN，取安全係數 2.5 得 48 kN。平台荷重：靜載 250 t、活載 90 t、模板摩擦 2 kPa×(150 m×2 面×1.2 m) = 720 kN，合計 ≈ 4,055 kN，需約 4,055/48 ≈ 84 支千斤頂。數值為教學假設。~A 48.3×4 mm tube rod has I ≈ 137,700 mm⁴; with 1.5 m unbraced, P_cr = π²EI/L² = π²×200,000×137,700/1,500² ≈ 121 kN, or 48 kN with a factor of 2.5. Deck loads: 250 t dead, 90 t live and form friction 2 kPa×(150 m×2 faces×1.2 m) = 720 kN, total about 4,055 kN, needing about 4,055/48 ≈ 84 jacks. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 滑模設計計算書須列出每支千斤頂的分擔荷重、爬桿挫屈長度與安全係數，並由滑模設計者簽認；現場在開滑前檢查每支千斤頂油壓、行程與自動鎖定功能，滑升中巡查爬桿是否彎曲，平台堆料以標示的容許荷重管控。~The slipform design calculations must list each jack's share of load, rod buckling length and safety factor, signed by the slipform designer; before starting check each jack's pressure, stroke and automatic holding function, inspect rods for bending during sliding, and control deck stockpiles against posted load limits.
units.failure: 平台上集中堆放鋼筋，使局部千斤頂超載，爬桿在未支撐段彎曲，平台傾斜並把模板扭曲；斷電或油管破裂時若千斤頂沒有自動鎖定，整個平台可能下滑，造成人員墜落。~Concentrating rebar bundles on the deck overloads local jacks, rods bend in their unbraced length, the deck tilts and the forms are twisted; if power fails or a hose bursts and the jacks lack automatic holding, the whole deck may slide down and throw workers off.
units.misconception: 千斤頂額定荷重夠大，就代表爬桿與平台一定安全。~If the jack rating is high enough, the rods and deck must be safe.
units.practice: 平台上應以油漆或標牌劃出堆料區與容許荷重，吊料前由平台負責人確認；千斤頂與爬桿屬臨時工程關鍵構件，開滑前設停檢點由臨時工程設計者與施工主管共同簽認。~Mark stockpile zones and allowable loads on the deck with paint or signs and have the deck supervisor approve each delivery; jacks and rods are critical temporary-works components, so set a pre-start hold point signed by the temporary-works designer and the construction manager.

units.title: 鋼筋、埋件與開口的連續協調~Continuous coordination of rebar, embeds and openings
units.mechanism: 滑模不會停下來等人，所以鋼筋、門窗開口框、樓板連接用的預埋鋼板、續接器與機電套管，都必須在模板經過之前到位。亞特蘭大試驗塔的核心筒有近 190 個開口、超過 3,300 塊預埋鋼板，單一高程最多約 200 件；這使埋件定位成為滑模最主要的品質風險。樓板通常在核心筒完成後再施作，因此牆內必須預留續接器或剪力鍵與樓板相接，任何漏埋都只能事後鑽孔植筋。~A slipform never stops to wait, so rebar, door and window boxouts, embed plates for floor connections, couplers and services sleeves must all be in place before the form passes. The Atlanta test tower's core had nearly 190 openings and over 3,300 embed plates, with up to about 200 pieces at a single elevation, which made embed placement the main quality risk of the slipform. Floors are usually built after the core, so the walls must contain couplers or shear keys to receive them, and any missed item can only be fixed later by drilling and bonding.
units.model: 埋件 3,300 件、滑升約 54 天，平均每天 3,300/54 ≈ 61 件，相當於每小時約 2.5 件。水平筋：牆長 150 m、雙面、間距 200 mm，每米高 5 層×2 面×150 m = 1,500 m，φ16 每米 1.58 kg，約 2,370 kg/m；日升 2.29 m 時每天約 5.4 t 水平筋。數值中的埋件數與天數取自公開報導，其餘為教學假設。~3,300 embeds over about 54 days of sliding average 3,300/54 ≈ 61 per day, about 2.5 per hour. Horizontal bars: 150 m of wall, two faces at 200 mm spacing give 5 layers×2 faces×150 m = 1,500 m per metre of height, at 1.58 kg/m for φ16 about 2,370 kg/m, or about 5.4 t per day at 2.29 m per day. Embed count and days come from public reporting; the rest are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以三維模型產生按高程排序的埋件與開口清單，每件有編號、座標與照片欄；平台上設專人在模板通過前逐件勾核位置與固定，並由測量人員以全站儀抽測關鍵埋件，紀錄與滑升日誌同步。~Generate an elevation-sorted list of embeds and openings from the 3D model, each with a number, coordinates and a photo field; assign a person on the deck to tick off position and fixing of each item before the form passes, have surveyors check key embeds with a total station, and keep the records in step with the slip log.
units.failure: 埋件高程錯誤或漏埋，樓板鋼梁無法連接，只能事後鑽孔植入錨栓，承載力與耐久都打折；開口框固定不牢在滑升中被拖動，門洞位置偏移，電梯門框無法安裝。~Embeds at the wrong level or missing leave floor beams with nothing to connect to, forcing post-drilled anchors with reduced capacity and durability; poorly fixed boxouts dragged by the moving form shift door openings so that elevator door frames cannot be installed.
units.misconception: 滑模速度快，所以埋件位置可以完工後再用鑽孔方式補做。~Because slipforming is fast, embed positions can be added afterwards by drilling.
units.practice: 開滑前凍結埋件與開口設計，之後的變更要經過專門的變更程序並在平台上公告；每一高程的埋件勾核表需由平台品管人員與監造簽名，未簽不得繼續滑升超過該高程。~Freeze the embed and opening design before sliding starts, route later changes through a dedicated change procedure posted on the deck, and require the deck quality controller and the resident engineer to sign each elevation's checklist before sliding continues past it.

units.anchor: 垂直度與扭轉控制~Verticality and twist control
units.title: 垂直度、扭轉與平台水平的修正~Correcting verticality, twist and deck level
units.mechanism: 滑模的幾何誤差會沿高度累積：平台只要稍微傾斜，模板就會往低側漂移；千斤頂行程不一致會讓平台扭轉，核心筒隨之旋轉。修正不能一次大幅調整，因為模板內的混凝土尚未硬化，突然改變方向會在牆面留下錯台或裂縫，只能以小坡度在數公尺高度內逐漸拉回。CN Tower 塔身邊升邊收窄，更需要精確控制幾何。亞特蘭大試驗塔的牆面垂直偏差控制在約 ±6 mm（±¼ in）以內。~Slipform geometry errors accumulate with height: a slightly tilted deck makes the forms drift toward the low side, and uneven jack strokes twist the deck so the core rotates. Corrections cannot be large and sudden, because the concrete in the form has not hardened and an abrupt change leaves steps or cracks; drift must be pulled back gradually over several metres at a small gradient. The CN Tower shaft narrowed as it rose, demanding even tighter geometric control. At the Atlanta test tower the vertical surface deviation was held within about ±6 mm (±¼ in).
units.model: 若量到核心筒偏離 20 mm，以 1:500 的修正坡度拉回，需要的修正高度 = 20 mm×500 = 10 m；日升 2.29 m 時約需 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 天才能完全修正，所以偏差必須在小時就被發現。數值為教學假設。~If the core is found 20 mm off line and corrected at a gradient of 1:500, the correction height is 20 mm×500 = 10 m; at 2.29 m per day that takes about 10/2.29 ≈ 4.4 days, so deviations must be caught while still small. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以雷射垂準儀從底部基準點向平台上的接收靶投點，每班至少量測兩次並記錄 x、y 偏移與平台扭轉角；平台水平以水管水準或數位傾斜計監測，量測值超過警戒值時由滑模工程師下達修正指令。~Project from base reference points to targets on the deck with laser plumbs at least twice per shift, recording x and y offsets and deck rotation; monitor deck level with water levels or digital inclinometers, and have the slipform engineer issue correction instructions when readings exceed the alert value.
units.failure: 發現偏差後一次大幅傾斜模板強行修正，牆面出現明顯折角與水平裂縫，電梯導軌安裝困難；長期忽略平台扭轉，核心筒逐層旋轉，與外圍樓板鋼梁連接位置錯開。~Forcing a large single correction by tilting the forms leaves visible kinks and horizontal cracks in the wall and makes elevator rail installation difficult; ignoring deck twist for long lets the core rotate storey by storey so that connections to perimeter floor beams no longer line up.
units.misconception: 滑模偏了只要在下一段一次調回原位即可。~If the slipform drifts, it can simply be returned to position in the next lift.
units.practice: 測量紀錄應繪成隨高度變化的偏差曲線並張貼在平台上，讓各班看到趨勢而非單點數值；修正指令與執行結果都寫入滑升日誌，由測量主管與滑模工程師簽記。~Plot survey results as deviation-versus-height curves posted on the deck so each shift sees the trend rather than a single reading; write correction instructions and their results into the slip log, signed by the survey lead and the slipform engineer.

units.anchor: 計畫停機與冷縫~Planned stops and cold joints
units.title: 計畫停機、冷縫處理與惡劣天候~Planned stops, cold joints and bad weather
units.mechanism: 滑模雖以連續作業為原則，但遇到樓層大改變、設備維修、強風或供料中斷，仍需要停機。停機時要讓模板內混凝土澆到預定高程並持續以小行程「鬆模」，避免混凝土與模板黏結；重新啟動前則要把接縫面打毛、清潔與濕潤，形成可傳遞剪力的施工縫。亞特蘭大試驗塔 24 小時連續作業，期間安排了三次各約一天的停機，並在這些位置形成冷縫。冷縫是剪力牆受力的薄弱面，必須按剪力摩擦檢核。~Although slipforming aims to be continuous, major changes of section, equipment maintenance, strong winds or supply interruptions still force stops. When stopping, concrete is brought to a planned level and the forms are jogged in small strokes to keep concrete from bonding to them; before restarting, the joint surface is roughened, cleaned and wetted to form a construction joint that can transfer shear. The Atlanta test tower worked 24 hours a day with three planned stops of about a day each, which formed cold joints at those levels. A cold joint is a weak plane in a shear wall and must be checked by shear friction.
units.model: 剪力摩擦 V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y。垂直筋 φ16@200 雙面，A_vf = 2×201/0.2 = 2,010 mm²/m；f_y = 420 MPa；接縫打毛 μ = 1.0 時 φV_n = 0.75×1.0×2,010×420 ≈ 633 kN/m，大於需求 500 kN/m；若未打毛 μ = 0.6，φV_n ≈ 380 kN/m，不足。數值為教學假設。~Shear friction V_n = μ·A_vf·f_y. Vertical bars φ16 at 200 mm on both faces give A_vf = 2×201/0.2 = 2,010 mm²/m; with f_y = 420 MPa and a roughened joint μ = 1.0, φV_n = 0.75×1.0×2,010×420 ≈ 633 kN/m, above a demand of 500 kN/m; an unroughened joint with μ = 0.6 gives φV_n ≈ 380 kN/m, which is insufficient. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 停機前後各拍攝接縫面照片並量測打毛深度（例如以砂填法或深度規），重新澆置前檢查接縫是否清潔濕潤；冷縫位置與處理方式要記錄高程，並由結構設計者確認該位置的剪力需求與摩擦係數假設相符。~Photograph the joint before and after the stop and measure roughness amplitude with a sand-patch method or depth gauge; before restarting check that the joint is clean and damp; record the elevation and treatment of each cold joint and have the structural designer confirm that the shear demand there matches the friction coefficient assumed.
units.failure: 未預期的停機沒有鬆模，模板與混凝土黏死，重啟時強拉撕裂牆面；冷縫未打毛就續澆，接縫成為光滑弱面，地震或強風下沿縫滑移並滲水。~An unplanned stop without jogging locks the forms to the concrete and restarting tears the wall; continuing over an unroughened cold joint leaves a smooth weak plane that can slip and leak under earthquake or strong wind.
units.misconception: 滑模混凝土是連續澆置的，所以牆內不會有施工縫。~Slipformed walls are cast continuously, so they never contain construction joints.
units.practice: 施工計畫要預先規劃停機高程（避開高剪力區與埋件密集區），並備妥非預期停機的應變程序：鬆模頻率、停止澆置高程、接縫處理與重啟檢查，由滑模工程師負責下令。~Plan stop elevations in advance, away from high-shear zones and dense embed bands, and prepare a contingency procedure for unplanned stops covering jogging frequency, the level at which pouring stops, joint treatment and restart checks, with the slipform engineer responsible for giving the orders.

units.anchor: 出模面檢查與成熟度~Exit-surface checks and maturity
units.title: 出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法~Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method
units.mechanism: 滑模每天要決定好幾次速度，不可能每次等試體壓驗結果，所以實務上同時使用即時檢查與預測方法：出模面的手壓或貫入檢查、溫度感測器配合成熟度法估計早齡強度，以及定期的標準試體作最終驗收。成熟度法假設同一配比在相同溫度—時間累積下會達到相同強度，因此先在試驗室建立成熟度與強度曲線，現場只要量測混凝土溫度就能推估強度。這對日夜溫差大或冬季施工尤其重要。~A slipform needs speed decisions several times a day and cannot wait for cylinder results each time, so practice combines immediate checks with prediction: thumb or penetration checks at the exit surface, temperature sensors with the maturity method to estimate early strength, and standard cylinders for final acceptance. The maturity method assumes that a given mix reaches the same strength at the same accumulated temperature–time, so a laboratory maturity–strength curve is built first and site strength is then estimated from concrete temperature alone. This matters most with large day–night swings or winter work.
units.model: Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt，基準溫度 T₀ = −10°C。20°C 時 10 h 累積 30×10 = 300 °C·h；若出模所需成熟度為 300 °C·h，10°C 時需 300/20 = 15 h。模板有效高度 1.0 m，容許速度由 0.10 m/h 降為 1.0/15 ≈ 0.067 m/h。數值為教學假設。~Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)Δt with datum T₀ = −10°C. Ten hours at 20°C accumulate 30×10 = 300 °C·h; if exit requires 300 °C·h, at 10°C it takes 300/20 = 15 h. With 1.0 m effective form height the rate must fall from 0.10 m/h to 1.0/15 ≈ 0.067 m/h. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 開工前以同一配比在試驗室建立成熟度—強度曲線，並以現場早期試體驗證；滑升中在模板下緣附近埋設溫度感測器，每小時計算成熟度，與出模面手壓檢查結果互相印證，最終強度以標準養護試體驗收。~Build the maturity–strength curve for the mix in the laboratory before starting and validate it with early site specimens; during sliding embed temperature sensors near the form bottom, compute maturity hourly and cross-check with exit-surface thumb tests, while final acceptance rests on standard-cured cylinders.
units.failure: 配比中途更換水泥來源卻沿用舊的成熟度曲線，推估強度偏高，出模混凝土實際太軟而坍落；感測器裝在受陽光直射的位置，讀到的溫度偏高，同樣導致高估強度。~Changing the cement source mid-job while keeping the old maturity curve overestimates strength, so concrete leaves the form too soft and slumps; sensors placed in direct sun read high temperatures and likewise overestimate strength.
units.misconception: 混凝土在模板內放滿固定小時數就一定可以出模，與溫度無關。~Concrete can always leave the form after a fixed number of hours regardless of temperature.
units.practice: 任何配比、水泥或摻料來源變更都要重新建立或驗證成熟度曲線；感測器位置與遮蔽方式寫入品質計畫，資料自動上傳並設警戒值，夜班也能即時看到強度推估。~Re-establish or validate the maturity curve after any change of mix, cement or admixture source; write sensor positions and shielding into the quality plan, upload data automatically with alert thresholds so the night shift sees strength estimates in real time.

units.anchor: 平台水平與千斤頂同步~Deck level and jack synchronisation
units.title: 千斤頂同步、平台水平量測與滑升日誌~Jack synchronisation, deck levelling and the slip log
units.mechanism: 滑模平台由數十支千斤頂同時推升，每支每一行程只上升數十毫米；只要部分千斤頂行程略短，平台就會逐漸傾斜。現代滑模以集中油壓與水平感測自動控制，但仍需人員定期量測並調整。滑升日誌是滑模的「黑盒子」：記錄每小時的高程、速度、混凝土溫度與供料、千斤頂狀況、偏差量測、停機與修正，日後若牆體出現問題，可以追溯到當時的作業條件。亞特蘭大試驗塔的千斤頂約每 15 分鐘把平台頂升約 25 mm（1 in）。~Dozens of jacks lift the deck together, each stroke only tens of millimetres; if some jacks stroke slightly short, the deck gradually tilts. Modern slipforms use central hydraulics with level sensing and automatic control, yet people must still measure and adjust regularly. The slip log is the slipform's black box: it records hourly level, rate, concrete temperature and supply, jack condition, deviation readings, stops and corrections, so that any later problem in the wall can be traced to the conditions at the time. At the Atlanta test tower the jacks lifted the deck about 25 mm (1 in) roughly every 15 minutes.
units.model: 千斤頂行程 25 mm，若某群組每行程少 1 mm，10 個行程後高差 10 mm；平台寬 22 m 時傾斜 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200。若規定平台高差警戒值為 15 mm，相當於 15 個行程、約 375 mm 的滑升高度內就必須修正。數值為教學假設。~With a 25 mm jack stroke, a group that falls 1 mm short per stroke is 10 mm low after 10 strokes; across a 22 m deck that is a tilt of 10/22,000 ≈ 1:2,200. With a 15 mm deck-level alert value, correction is needed within 15 strokes, about 375 mm of rise. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每班以水準儀或水管水準量測平台四角與中間點高程，與自動系統讀值比對；滑升日誌以固定格式每小時填寫，並由當班滑模主管與品管簽名，電子化日誌應自動記錄千斤頂油壓與行程計數。~Each shift level the deck corners and mid-points with an optical level or water level and compare with the automatic system; fill in the slip log hourly in a fixed format signed by the shift slipform supervisor and quality controller, and have an electronic log record jack pressures and stroke counts automatically.
units.failure: 依賴自動控制而長期不做人工量測，感測器故障時平台逐漸傾斜卻無人察覺，模板扭曲並使牆厚不均；日誌缺漏或事後補寫，發生牆面缺陷時無法判斷是速度、溫度還是供料造成。~Relying on automatic control without manual checks means a failed sensor can let the deck tilt unnoticed, twisting the forms and making the wall uneven in thickness; gaps or after-the-fact entries in the log make it impossible to tell whether a defect came from rate, temperature or supply.
units.misconception: 自動化液壓系統會讓所有千斤頂完全同步，不需要人工量測。~Automated hydraulics keep every jack perfectly synchronised, so manual levelling is unnecessary.
units.practice: 滑升日誌格式要在開工前由監造核定，紀錄項目包含時間、高程、速度、溫度、坍度、車次、偏差、千斤頂異常與修正指令；日誌每日掃描備份，作為竣工資料的一部分。~Have the resident engineer approve the slip-log format before starting, covering time, level, rate, temperatures, slump, truck numbers, deviations, jack faults and correction orders; scan and back up the log daily as part of the as-built record.

units.anchor: 出模面修飾與養護~Exit-surface finishing and curing
units.title: 出模後修飾、養護與耐久~Finishing, curing and durability after exit
units.mechanism: 混凝土出模時表面仍很年輕，懸吊在平台下方的修飾架讓工人可以立即抹平小缺陷、填補小孔洞，並施加養護。高層核心筒外側常暴露在強風中，年輕混凝土表面水分蒸發極快，容易產生塑性收縮裂縫與表面粉化，降低保護層的耐久性。冬季則要防止出模混凝土受凍；亞特蘭大試驗塔在寒冷多雨的天氣下，混凝土本身的水化熱有助於維持溫度。修飾架也是人員作業區，需要護欄與防墜網。~Concrete leaving the form is very young, and finishing scaffolds hung below the deck let workers immediately float small defects, fill small holes and apply curing. The outside of a high core is often exposed to strong wind, so water evaporates very fast from young surfaces, causing plastic shrinkage cracks and dusting that reduce the durability of the cover. In winter, exiting concrete must be protected from freezing; at the Atlanta test tower, heat of hydration helped keep the concrete warm in cold, rainy weather. The finishing scaffold is also a work area that needs guardrails and fall-arrest netting.
units.model: 蒸發率 E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶（kg/m²/h）。混凝土與氣溫 25°C、相對濕度 r = 0.4、風速 29 km/h（約 8 m/s）時 E = 5×(12,124 − 4,850)×33×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.2 kg/m²/h，超過常用的 1.0 kg/m²/h 警戒值，需要養護劑或圍幕防風。數值為教學假設。~Evaporation rate E = 5[(T_c+18)^2.5 − r(T_a+18)^2.5](V+4)×10⁻⁶ in kg/m²/h. With concrete and air at 25°C, r = 0.4 and wind 29 km/h (about 8 m/s), E = 5×(12,124 − 4,850)×33×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.2 kg/m²/h, above the common 1.0 kg/m²/h caution level, so curing compound or wind screens are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在平台高度設風速計與溫濕度計，每班計算蒸發率並記錄養護措施；定期以回彈錘或表面吸水試驗比較不同高程的表層品質，發現粉化或裂縫時檢討養護方式。~Install an anemometer and temperature–humidity sensor at deck level, compute evaporation each shift and log curing measures; compare surface quality at different heights periodically with a rebound hammer or surface absorption tests, and revise curing when dusting or cracking appears.
units.failure: 強風下出模面只做抹平未養護，表面細密裂縫與粉化使保護層透水性升高，日後碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕提前；修飾架缺乏圍幕時，工人也暴露在高處強風與墜落風險下。~Floating the exit surface without curing in strong wind leaves fine cracks and dusting that make the cover more permeable, bringing forward carbonation and bar corrosion; finishing scaffolds without screens also expose workers to high wind and fall hazards.
units.misconception: 核心筒以後會被裝修包覆，所以滑模牆面的養護不重要。~Core walls will be covered by finishes later, so curing slipformed surfaces does not matter.
units.practice: 養護方法（養護劑、噴霧或圍幕）與適用風速條件要寫入施工計畫；修飾架的護欄、防墜網與緊急逃生路線在開滑前檢查，並在每次平台改裝後重新檢查。~Write curing methods (compound, misting or screens) and the wind conditions for each into the method statement; inspect guardrails, fall-arrest nets and escape routes on the finishing scaffold before sliding starts and again after every deck modification.

units.anchor: 竣工偏差與交接紀錄~As-built deviation and handover records
units.title: 竣工量測、偏差統計與工程交接~As-built survey, deviation statistics and handover
units.mechanism: 滑模核心筒完成後，後續的樓板、鋼梁、電梯導軌與帷幕牆都以核心筒為基準，所以核心筒的實際位置比設計位置更重要。竣工量測要提供每一高程的牆面位置、垂直度、扭轉、開口與埋件實際座標，讓後續工種調整連接。羅特魏爾試驗塔直徑約 21 m、內含 12 個井道，殼體高約 232 m，井道的垂直度直接決定電梯試驗能否進行。交接資料還應包括冷縫位置、修補紀錄與強度試驗結果，作為日後鑽孔、補強或變更用途的依據。~Once a slipformed core is complete, floors, steel beams, elevator rails and the façade all reference it, so the core's actual position matters more than its design position. The as-built survey must give wall position, verticality, twist and the actual coordinates of openings and embeds at each level so following trades can adjust their connections. The Rottweil test tower, about 21 m in diameter with 12 shafts and a shell about 232 m tall, shows how shaft verticality decides whether elevator testing can proceed at all. Handover records should also include cold-joint locations, repair records and strength results, as the basis for later drilling, strengthening or change of use.
units.model: 40 個測點的垂直偏差平均 4 mm、標準差 3 mm，95% 上界 ≈ 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm。以 ACI 117 對高度超過約 25 m 者取高度 1/1,000、上限約 150 mm 的概念，120 m 核心筒容許約 120 mm，實測遠在容許內；但電梯導軌要求常更嚴，須另行比對。數值為教學假設。~Forty survey points with a mean verticality deviation of 4 mm and standard deviation 3 mm give a 95% upper bound of about 4 + 1.96×3 ≈ 9.9 mm. Using the ACI 117 concept of 1/1,000 of height for heights above about 25 m, capped at about 150 mm, a 120 m core is allowed about 120 mm, so the result is well within; elevator rail requirements are often stricter and must be checked separately. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 竣工量測以獨立於施工測量的控制點進行，結果與滑升日誌中的每班量測比對，差異需可解釋；電梯井道另以雷射掃描或吊線量測淨尺寸，交給電梯廠商確認導軌安裝可行。~Carry out the as-built survey from control points independent of the construction survey, compare it with the shift readings in the slip log and explain any differences; survey elevator shaft clear dimensions separately by laser scanning or plumb lines and give them to the elevator supplier to confirm rail installation is feasible.
units.failure: 竣工資料只交一張總體垂直度數字，後續鋼梁廠商依設計座標製作，到現場才發現埋件偏移，大量現場修改；冷縫與修補位置未記錄，多年後在冷縫處鑽孔或開口，削弱牆體剪力傳遞。~Handing over only a single overall verticality figure leads steel fabricators to work to design coordinates and find displaced embeds on site, forcing extensive field modifications; with cold joints and repairs unrecorded, someone later drills or cuts openings at a cold joint and weakens shear transfer.
units.misconception: 核心筒驗收只要總高度與整體垂直度合格就足夠。~A core passes acceptance if its total height and overall verticality are within tolerance.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含按高程排列的竣工座標表、埋件與開口實測表、冷縫與修補位置圖、強度試驗彙整與滑升日誌；任何日後在核心筒上鑽孔或開口，都須先查閱這些資料並經結構工程師核准。~Handover should include elevation-ordered as-built coordinate tables, measured embed and opening tables, maps of cold joints and repairs, strength-test summaries and the slip log; any future drilling or opening in the core must consult these records and be approved by a structural engineer.

example: 規劃練習：一座 120 m 高的核心筒，牆體總長 150 m、厚 0.4 m，以滑模施工。模板高 1.2 m、頂部預留 0.2 m，20°C 時初凝 4 h，容許速度上限 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h，採用 0.10 m/h 保留裕度；日升 2.4 m，純滑升 120/2.4 = 50 天，加上 3 次計畫停機各 1 天，約 53 天。混凝土供應 150×0.4×0.10 = 6.0 m³/h，全程約 150×0.4×120 = 7,200 m³。平台荷重約 4,055 kN，爬桿 48.3×4 mm 在 1.5 m 無支撐長的容許荷重約 48 kN，需約 84 支千斤頂。若改在冬季施工，成熟度要求使速度降為約 0.067 m/h：純滑升 120/(0.067×24) ≈ 75 天，供料降為約 4.0 m³/h，工期增加約 25 天，但千斤頂數量不變。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的施工計畫。~Planning exercise: a 120 m core with 150 m of wall at 0.4 m thick is slipformed. With 1.2 m forms and 0.2 m freeboard and initial set at 4 h at 20°C, the upper rate limit is 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h, and 0.10 m/h is chosen for margin; the core rises 2.4 m a day, so sliding takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, about 53 days with three planned one-day stops. Concrete supply is 150×0.4×0.10 = 6.0 m³/h, about 150×0.4×120 = 7,200 m³ in total. Deck load is about 4,055 kN and a 48.3×4 mm rod with 1.5 m unbraced length allows about 48 kN, so about 84 jacks are needed. In winter the maturity requirement cuts the rate to about 0.067 m/h: sliding takes 120/(0.067×24) ≈ 75 days, supply falls to about 4.0 m³/h and the programme grows by about 25 days, while the number of jacks is unchanged. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building's construction plan.
history: 滑模源自筒倉與煙囪這類斷面固定的高聳結構，因可連續成形而被引入高塔與高層核心筒。1973 年 2 月動工的多倫多 CN Tower 以液壓爬升千斤頂推動的模具連續澆築約 335 m 的六角形混凝土塔身，並邊升邊收窄形成錐形，1975 年 4 月完工。2014 至 2016 年 Züblin 以滑模建造羅特魏爾高 246 m 的電梯試驗塔；2020 年亞特蘭大的電梯試驗塔由奧地利滑模專業廠商 Gleitbau 負責滑模設計與督導，核心筒約 54 天完成。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Slipforming grew out of silos and chimneys, tall structures of constant section, and was brought into towers and high-rise cores because it forms walls continuously. Toronto's CN Tower, started in February 1973, cast its hexagonal concrete shaft of about 335 m in a mould pushed up by hydraulic climbing jacks that narrowed as it rose to form the taper, and was completed in April 1975. Between 2014 and 2016 Züblin slipformed the 246 m elevator test tower in Rottweil, and in 2020 the Atlanta elevator test tower used the Austrian slipform specialist Gleitbau for slipform design and supervision, completing its core in about 54 days. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: CN Tower 的混凝土塔身約 335 m，以液壓爬升千斤頂推動的滑動模具連續成形~The CN Tower's concrete shaft of about 335 m was formed continuously in a mould pushed up by hydraulic climbing jacks
CN Tower 總高約 553 m，1973 年 2 月動工、1975 年 4 月完工~The CN Tower is about 553 m tall, started in February 1973 and completed in April 1975
亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔核心筒約 121 m（398.5 ft），滑模約 54 天完成，平均日升約 2.3 m（7.5 ft）~The Atlanta elevator test tower core of about 121 m (398.5 ft) was slipformed in about 54 days, averaging about 2.3 m (7.5 ft) per day
亞特蘭大試驗塔模板高約 1.2 m（4 ft），千斤頂約每 15 分鐘頂升約 25 mm~The Atlanta test tower forms were about 1.2 m (4 ft) high and the jacks lifted about 25 mm every 15 minutes
亞特蘭大試驗塔核心筒有近 190 個開口與超過 3,300 塊預埋鋼板~The Atlanta test tower core had nearly 190 openings and more than 3,300 embed plates

羅特魏爾試驗塔高 246 m、直徑約 21 m，內含 12 個井道，尖峰日殼體上升可達約 4 m~The Rottweil test tower is 246 m tall and about 21 m in diameter with 12 shafts, its shell rising up to about 4 m on peak days
